newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle $103/dressed, moderate - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle $103/dressed, moderate - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderately active, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly steady, with Tuesday on both live and dressed basis sales. Buyer and seller interest fairly good.

However, some sellers pricing their offering $1.00-$2.00 per cwt higher than current market. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1350 lbs 62.00-63.00; Dressed basis mostly 102.00, few 101.50, few 102.50-103.00. ( weighted average 102.08).

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 63.00; Dressed basis mostly 102.00, few 100.00-101.50, few 102.50-103.00 ( weighted average 102.01). Confirmed - 11,800 Last Week - 13,400 Last Year - 23,200 Wk To Date - 69,400 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 105,500 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 77,900
